papers.title: Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds
papers.status: Draft; finite norm, marked diagram coefficient and invariant normalization proved together
imports: The enhanced ribbon definition of the reduced Kashaev invariant; the matrix and normalization comparison are proved in the paper.

papers.title: Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources
papers.status: Draft; uniform local upper bounds with protected zeros and both level parities
imports: Finite Fourier/Casimir identification from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 4.1 and equations (4.4)–(4.5).

papers.title: Holomorphic asymptotics of central shared face coefficients
papers.status: Draft; nonzero holomorphic central coefficient and shared spectral gap at all integer levels
imports: Exact local Fourier/Casimir and marked coefficient identities from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 4.1 and Theorem 9.1.
Uniform cofactor bounds and the absolutely normalized triangle action from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Sections 3–5.
A positive stationary radius vector is an explicit analytic hypothesis; the classical packing theorem supplies it for matched spheres.

papers.title: Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists
papers.status: Draft; conditional whole-sum asymptotic from an explicit local expansion and shared global gap
imports: Exact midpoint Hermite identity from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Section 3.
The theorem assumes a nonzero holomorphic source expansion and a strict shared spectral gap; their construction for a knot and the action-volume equality are separate application inputs.

papers.title: Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links
papers.status: Draft; classical complete geometry, original primitive fillings and absolute action-volume equality
imports: Elementary holomorphic implicit function theorem, differential forms and Stokes, and the ideal-tetrahedron Lobachevsky volume formula.
No quantum asymptotic or whole-character-variety uniqueness is assumed.

papers.title: Volume limits for long alternating-generator three-braids
papers.status: Draft application paper; the shared analytic and geometric inputs are stated explicitly
imports: Exact source identity, invariant normalization and uniform Hermite filling norm from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds.
Uniform local sector estimates from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Theorem 1.1.

Actual central expansion and shared spectral gap from Holomorphic asymptotics of central shared face coefficients, Theorem 1.1; entire-sum evaluation from Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists, Theorem 1.1.
Original primitive completion and absolute volume from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Theorem 1.1.
